This section takes effect in daily work starting immediately and applies to every trip handled by the Companion Animal Travel Desk.

Companion Animal Travel Desk procedures. This purpose of this section is to keep companion animal travel coordination smooth from booking through skyport pickup. In our operations, the department works with the passenger handling teams to confirm documentation, confirm cabin suitability, and align pickup timing at the destination skyport so that the traveler and Cali experience a calm, predictable flow. For boarding, the check-in team uses FM-597 to confirm the companion's travel readiness.

Before travel day, the desk verifies that the booking notes are complete and that the traveler contact details are current, then we coordinate with the relevant skyport staff to reserve the handling window. The goal is to prevent last-minute crowding, reduce waiting, and ensure that any care instructions are matched to the companion's needs. When Rafael Clark or Sofia Haddad are part of the itinerary, we record their arrival expectations in the internal queue and share the same pickup plan with the skyport liaison so the handoff remains consistent.

On arrival, the desk confirms the companion animal’s status with the check-in team, ensures that any required handling steps are carried out in the correct order, and monitors the transition from ticketing to baggage or carry arrangements. Throughout the day, we keep communication warm and direct: the senior coordinator aligns the traveler with the correct point of contact, the care coordinator tracks completion of required steps, and the skyport pickup team confirms the pickup area readiness. If changes arise, we update the operational notes promptly and inform the traveler of the revised flow without causing additional disruptions.

All staff should follow these procedures end to end and treat every companion animal with care, patience, and respect. For help with an unusual itinerary or a documentation issue, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk coordinator at Aurelia Skyways.
